records.title: The Drop — live mix moment reel
records.description: High-energy reel capturing the moment the beat drops during a live mix. Start with 2 seconds of build-up tension (crowd reaction, hands on the mixer), then cut to the drop with the bass hitting. Quick cuts between wide shot of the decks and close-ups of your hands on the fader. Use the actual audio from the set — no trending sound needed when the mix speaks for itself. Caption: 'That moment when the beat drops and the crowd goes with it 🔥 Track ID in comments. #djlife #djset #beatdrop #zaymynameofficial'

records.title: Live DJ set highlight reel
records.description: 30-60 second clip of a live DJ set or practice session. Use trending audio or original mix. Hook in first 2 seconds — drop a quick teaser of the best moment. Caption with gig details or track IDs.

records.title: Gear breakdown carousel
records.description: Photo carousel showing the DJ setup — controller, mixer, laptop, lighting. Break down each piece of gear with what it does and why you use it. Great for saves and shares.

records.title: Beat-making timelapse — start to finish
records.description: Screen recording + talking head of building a beat from scratch. Show the before/after — empty project to full arrangement. Timelapse style with a final playthrough at the end.

records.title: 5 production tips carousel
records.description: 5-slide carousel with practical production tips — sound selection, mixing, arrangement, etc. Each slide = one tip with a short explanation. High-save format.

records.title: 3D print timelapse — design to finished product
records.description: Timelapse of a 3D print from start to finish. Clean aesthetic, satisfying watch. Show the final product at the end with a quick demo of it in use. Use trending audio.

records.title: 3D printing 'thing of the week' showcase
records.description: Showcase a cool or unusual 3D print. Quick hook — 'I printed something nobody asked for' or 'Wait for it' energy. Final reveal with product demo.

records.title: Inspirational quote post — journey reflection
records.description: Clean text post with a motivational quote or personal reflection tied to your journey — music, creating, persistence. Simple, bold design. Good for saves and shares.

records.title: Story reel — a moment that changed everything
records.description: Spoken inspirational reel — talk to camera about a real moment of struggle or breakthrough in your creative journey. Raw, honest, no filter. Authentically connects with audience.

records.title: Behind the scenes — studio session
records.description: A day-in-the-life style reel showing behind-the-scenes of your creative process. Authentic, unfiltered, trending audio.

records.title: Hot take / opinion piece
records.description: Short clip with a bold statement or hot take related to your niche. Text overlay, trending sound, strong hook in first 2 seconds.

records.title: Carousel — 5 tips for your audience
records.description: Multi-slide carousel with tips, resources, or a mini-guide. High save rate format. Clean design, value-packed slides.
